decisions.reason: Turnaround management software sits at the core of the firm's announced shift toward data-driven airport operations and has had its own page since launch, so the visible commitment and investment make dropping it very unlikely.

The firm raised its commitment by giving the connectivity module its own page in 2024, and the module supports the integrated digital apron strategy, so writing it off would contradict a recent public escalation.

Billing software sits a little further from the operational core, but the firm upgraded it to its own page in 2024 and it extends the expanded software offering, so management will likely persist and treat any slow uptake as temporary.

Equipment monitoring software builds directly on the firm's installed hardware base and its maintenance services, and it gained its own page in 2024, so the firm is publicly committed to it and has strong reasons to continue.
